## Conventional Commit & SemVer Impact
<!-- Verify your PR title follows Conventional Commits: feat: ..., fix: ..., chore: ... -->
- [ ] PR title adheres to Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat(scope): summary` or `fix: summary`)
- [ ] Breaking changes (if any) are highlighted with `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` in description

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability (bumps SemVer MINOR)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (bumps SemVer PATCH)
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement (bumps SemVer PATCH)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, dependencies, or tool configuration

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Local build and lint passed cleanly (`npm run lint`, `pytest`, `colcon test`, etc.)
- [ ] Hardware / Simulation tested (if applicable)
- [ ] No temporary debug scripts or compiled binaries tracked
